mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.password AS password, utr.id AS userTenantRelId, utr.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, t.status AS tenantStatus FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_tenant_rel utr ON u.id = utr.user_id AND utr.is_default = true AND utr.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' LEFT JOIN sys_tenant t ON utr.tenant_id = t.id AND t.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' WHERE u.user_name = #{username} AND u.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' LIMIT 1

SELECT t.id AS tenantId, t.tenant_code AS tenantCode, t.tenant_name AS tenantName, t.status AS tenantStatus FROM sys_user_tenant_rel utr INNER JOIN sys_tenant t ON utr.tenant_id = t.id AND t.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED' WHERE utr.user_id = #{userId} AND utr.is_deleted = 'NOT_DELETED'
